articles.title: 22k gold rate today: Check 24k, 22k, 18k gold prices (May 30, 2026) at IBJA, Tanishq, Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers and Malabar Gold & Diamonds
articles.summary: Gold prices in India continued to ease on Saturday, May 30, 2026, with major jewellery retailers reporting lower rates compared to Friday. This nationwide decline is primarily driven by softer global bullion trends, making gold more affordable. The movement reflects broader international market influences impacting domestic precious metal valuations and consumer purchasing decisions across India.

articles.title: All for one: Norway, Germany sell Canada on shared submarine fleet
articles.summary: Norway and Germany are jointly pitching the Type 212CD submarine to Canada, employing an "all-for-one, one-for-all" strategy. This collaborative lobbying aims to secure a significant defence contract, influencing Canada's naval modernization. The Type 212CD is presented as a crucial asset for Canada's future maritime security, showcasing international defence procurement dynamics.

articles.title: instrumation 0.4.0
articles.summary: A recent technical malfunction prevented a crucial website component from loading, potentially disrupting user access. Users encountering this issue are advised to thoroughly check their network connection, disable interfering browser extensions like ad blockers, or consider switching to a different web browser. These steps are recommended to troubleshoot and restore full functionality, ensuring a smooth online experience.

articles.title: Gen Chauhan exits as CDS after leading tri-services integration efforts
articles.summary: Outgoing Chief of Defence Staff Gen Anil Chauhan concluded his three-year-and-eight-month tenure at the top military post, describing his service as "very satisfying." His stint as CDS involved crucial responsibilities for defence integration and strategic planning. This transition signifies a notable change in India's highest military leadership, impacting future armed forces reforms and national security preparedness.

articles.title: Military exercise Pragati concludes in Meghalaya with participation from 13 nations
articles.summary: The maiden multilateral military exercise 'Pragati 2026' recently concluded in Umroi, Meghalaya, bringing together armies from 13 nations. Focused on countering insurgency and enhancing interoperability among participating forces, this significant exercise underscores India's growing role in regional security cooperation and its commitment to fostering strategic partnerships, crucial for addressing complex modern security challenges.

articles.title: Russian nuclear-capable Oreshnik missile fired in January was 9 years old, Ukrainian experts say
articles.summary: Ukrainian experts reveal a Russian Oreshnik missile, fired at Ukraine in January, was manufactured nine years ago. Its examination showed it comprised solely Russian and Belarusian components. This finding suggests Russia's sustained capability to produce advanced weaponry indigenously or with close allies, potentially circumventing international sanctions for critical parts, and offers insights into the age of munitions employed in the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: UFO-linked general held classified meeting with Pentagon unit, then disappeared
articles.summary: Retired US Air Force Major General William Neil McCasland mysteriously vanished from his Albuquerque home after a dinner meeting with U.S. Space Force members. His disappearance is notable as he left behind his phone, glasses, and tracking devices. This incident raises questions pertinent to personnel security within defence establishments, given his high-ranking background.

articles.title: "All three services preparing well for Operation Sindoor 2.0, if it takes place": COAS General Upendra Dwivedi
articles.summary: COAS General Upendra Dwivedi stated that all three branches of the Indian Armed Forces – Army, Navy, and Air Force – are preparing diligently for "Operation Sindoor 2.0." He emphasized the forces' readiness to respond effectively should the need arise. This highlights India's integrated operational preparedness and proactive approach to national security challenges.
